newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang to produce 25 mln T oil in 2000.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang to produce 25 mln T oil in 2000.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjiang will produce 25 million tonnes of crude oil in 2000, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
The resource-rich region would also produce 250,000 ounces of gold and more than 70,000 tonnes of major metals in 2000, Xinhua said without elaborating.
Coal output in the region was forecast to hit 33 million tonnes in the year, it said.
China hoped to find an additional 1.5 billion tonnes of oil reserves, 370 billion cubic metres of natural gas, 4.0 billion tonnes of coal and 120 tonnes of gold, it said.
Xinjiang's crude oil output was nearly 13 million tonnes in 1995, up more than 12.5 percent from the year before, official figures show.
The region's gold output was six tonnes in 1995 while coal production was about 25 million tonnes.
